title: Entering a kit's context once its close started is refused with kit_closed
notes: Python: tests/test_kit_close.py::test_async_with_a_closed_kit_is_refused. Entering is the integrator's opening of the kit: roomkit's async with, roomkit-rs's start (README, enter). A channel's own doors (a realtime session's start, a conference arrival) are not observed here.
